title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR PUBLIC PREMISES (EVICTION OF UNAUTHORISED OCCUPANTS) ACT, 1988
full_text: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR PUBLIC PREMISES (EVICTION OF UNAUTHORISED OCCUPANTS) ACT, 1988 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198817 Act Number: 17 Enactment Date: 1988-08-31 Act Year: 1988 Short Title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR PUBLIC PREMISES (EVICTION OF UNAUTHORISED OCCUPANTS) ACT, 1988 Long Title: An Act to provide for the eviction of unauthorized occupants from public premises and for certain incidental matters. Department: Department of Housing and Urban Development Enforcement Date: 01-09-1988 Type: STATE Location: Jammu and Kashmir TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Appointment of estate officer. Section 4. Issue of notice to produce documents in proof of authorization of occupation. Section 5. Eviction of unauthorised occupants. Section 6. Power to remove unauthorised construction, etc. Section 7. Order of demolition of un-authorised construction. Section 8. Power to seal unauthorised construction Section 9. Disposal of property left on public premises by unauthorised occupants. Section 10. Power to require payment of rent or damages in respect of public premises. Section 11. Powers of estate officers. Section 12. Appeals Section 13. Finalty of orders. Section 14. Offences and penalty. Section 15. Offences under section 14 to be cognizable. Section 16. Power to obtain information Section 17. Liability of heirs and legal representatives. Section 18. Delegation of powers. Section 23. Power to make rules. Section 24. Repeal.
